findings.title: No Programmatic API — Struts Form-Based HTML Interface Only
findings.description: The application exposes only an Apache Struts 1.3 form-based HTML interface at /loan. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI endpoint exists. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No programmatic API. Only Struts ActionForm accepting HTTP POST with HTML JSP responses.
findings.recommendation: Create a REST API layer (Spring Boot or JAX-RS) that exposes loan pricing and application submission as JSON endpoints, documented with OpenAPI specification.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Create a REST API layer exposing loan pricing and submission as JSON endpoints.
blocker_remediation.target_state: RESTful API with JSON request/response bodies, documented with OpenAPI specification.
dependencies: Requires modernizing from Struts 1.3 to a supported framework

findings.title: No Idempotency Support for Write Operations
findings.description: The saveApplication() method performs a direct INSERT with no idempotency key, no deduplication check, and no unique constraint. Repeated submissions create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism — no idempotency key header, no unique business key constraint, no deduplication logic.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support and unique business key constraints to all write endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents retry on failure. Non-idempotent INSERT will create duplicate loan applications on retry.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add unique constraint on business key combination (applicant + principal + term).
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints accept idempotency key header; duplicates return original result.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application has no machine identity authentication. It relies on container-managed authentication via WebLogic (request.getRemoteUser()) with no support for service accounts, API keys, OAuth client credentials, or mTLS.
findings.gap: No service account authentication, no API key support, no OAuth2 client credentials, no mTLS. Only WebLogic container-managed human user authentication.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with principal attribution for machine callers.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication for machine callers.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Agent identities authenticated via dedicated service credentials with principal attribution.

findings.title: No Audit Logging for Write Operations
findings.description: The application has zero logging. No audit trail exists for write operations. The saveApplication() method performs an INSERT without logging the authenticated principal, operation, or request context.
findings.gap: No audit logging whatsoever. No log statements, no logging framework, no CloudTrail, no immutable log storage.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging for all write operations with principal attribution, stored in tamper-evident storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents must have full audit attribution. Zero logging means agent actions are undetectable and unauditable.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add structured audit logging for all write operations.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit trail (CloudTrail or equivalent) logging every write with principal attribution.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Write Operations
findings.description: The saveApplication() method performs a single INSERT with no compensation or rollback mechanism. No saga pattern, no compensating transaction, no undo endpoint.
findings.gap: No rollback capability, no compensating transactions, no saga pattern, no undo operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement transaction management with proper rollback on failure and compensating operations (cancel/void).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback mechanism
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step workflows leave partial state on failure without compensation.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement transaction management with rollback. Add compensating operations.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Multi-step operations support compensation or rollback. Failed workflows do not leave partial state.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Financial PII
findings.description: Financial loan application data (applicant names, loan amounts) stored in on-prem Oracle with no residency controls, no sovereignty policies, no mechanisms preventing agent transmission to LLM in different jurisdiction.
findings.gap: No data residency controls, no sovereignty policies, no regional data handling configuration.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Implement data classification. Configure regional LLM endpoints within compliance boundaries.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND financial PII with no residency controls
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agent accessing financial PII could transmit regulated data to LLM in different jurisdiction with no protective boundary.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Document data residency requirements for financial data.
blocker_remediation.target_state: Data residency policies enforced. Agent integrations use regional LLM endpoints within compliance boundaries.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions — All Users Have Identical Access
findings.description: No scoped permissions exist. All authenticated users have identical access to all operations. No mechanism to grant agent identity read-only or resource-specific access.
findings.gap: No RBAC, no ABAC, no IAM policies, no per-caller permission differentiation.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control or deploy API Gateway with IAM policies differentiating agent permissions.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with IAM-based resource policies
Implement reverse proxy with path-based authorization

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Single Struts action handles both read (pricing) and write (submission) with no permission check before write operation.
findings.gap: No read/write permission differentiation, no action-level access control.
findings.recommendation: Split pricing and submission into separate endpoints with distinct authorization requirements.

compensating_controls: Separate read/write into distinct endpoints
Add API Gateway with method-level authorization

findings.title: No Identity Propagation or Delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation. Uses request.getRemoteUser() with no token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows, no distinction between agent-as-self and agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No JWT parsing, no OAuth2 delegation, no token exchange, no identity type distinction.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange with claims distinguishing actor type (agent vs. human).

compensating_controls: Implement JWT-based identity propagation
Add X-On-Behalf-Of headers with validation

findings.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database credentials hardcoded as static final constants: DB_URL, DB_USER ('loan_app'), DB_PASS ('loanApp2010') in LoanAction.java lines 22-24. Committed to version control with no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials hardcoded in source. No Secrets Manager, no Vault, no rotation, no encryption.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credentials immediately. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Rotate exposed password.

compensating_controls: Immediately rotate exposed credentials
Move to Secrets Manager with automatic rotation

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No identity suspension mechanism. Cannot revoke individual agent identities without shutting down the entire application. No API keys, no service accounts to disable.
findings.gap: No identity revocation, no API key management, no service account disable mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key management or OAuth2 client credentials with individual identity revocation.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with API key management
Implement IP-based blocking at WAF/load balancer

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls for Write Operations
findings.description: No concurrency controls. Raw INSERT with no optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conditional writes. Concurrent agent instances could create race conditions.
findings.gap: No optimistic locking, no version fields, no conditional writes, no conflict detection.
findings.recommendation: Add optimistic locking with version columns and unique constraints on business keys.

compensating_controls: Add unique constraints on business key combinations
Implement optimistic locking with version columns

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No resilience patterns. Raw JDBC connection on every request (DriverManager.getConnection()) with no connection pooling, no timeout, no retry, no circuit breaker.
findings.gap: No circuit breakers, no retry logic, no timeout configuration, no connection pooling.
findings.recommendation: Replace direct DriverManager with connection pool. Add timeout and circuit breaker around database calls.

compensating_controls: Implement connection pooling with timeout config
Deploy circuit breaker pattern around database calls

findings.title: No Rate Limiting or Throttling at Any Layer
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no rate-limiting middleware. Runaway agent loop could submit unlimited loan applications.
findings.gap: Application completely unprotected from traffic storms.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling. Add WAF rate rules.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with throttling
Implement WebLogic connection limits

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits or blast radius controls. No per-caller operation caps, no business-level safeguards. Agent error could submit thousands of applications.
findings.gap: No per-caller transaction limits, no bulk operation caps, no business-domain caps.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-agent business transaction limits (e.g., max_applications_per_hour).

compensating_controls: Implement per-session submission limits
Deploy API Gateway usage plans with per-caller quotas

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State for Agent-Proposed Writes
findings.description: No draft or pending state. saveApplication() immediately commits loan application to database. No intermediate state for human review.
findings.gap: No PENDING/DRAFT status, no two-step commit, no approval workflow.
findings.recommendation: Add status-based workflow with PENDING state for agent-submitted applications requiring human approval.

compensating_controls: Add status column with PENDING/APPROVED states
Implement two-step API: create-then-confirm

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. All submissions processed immediately without configurable review step. No mechanism to require human approval for high-risk operations.
findings.gap: No approval API endpoints, no configurable operation-level flags, no human-in-the-loop workflow.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates per operation type or business rule (e.g., loan amount threshold).

compensating_controls: Route high-value loans to human approval queue
Add Step Functions with human approval tasks

findings.title: No Access Control Differentiation for Sensitive Financial Data
findings.description: Financial PII stored (applicant names, loan amounts). B1 CLEAR (no read API returns sensitive data). B2 fires: no access control differentiates sensitive vs non-sensitive data access. B3: no formal classification (INFO).
findings.gap: No access control differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data (B2).
findings.recommendation: Implement access control differentiation for sensitive financial data with OAuth scopes or RBAC.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: Stage A=Yes (financial PII stored), B1=CLEAR (no read API returns sensitive data), B2=RISK-SAFETY (no access differentiation)
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Financial PII (applicant names, loan amounts) stored. B1 clear because no read endpoints exist. B2 fires because single shared permission grants full access.

b1.reasoning: No read API endpoints return stored sensitive data — only writes and confirmation page.

b2.reasoning: No access controls distinguish sensitive from non-sensitive data access. Single shared permission for all.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists.

compensating_controls: Implement RBAC separating loan data access from admin
Add OAuth scopes separating data domains

findings.title: PII Leakage Risk Through Unhandled Exception Paths
findings.description: No PII redaction controls. SQL string concatenation with applicant names means PII can leak through database error messages, stack traces, and WebLogic server logs via unhandled exceptions.
findings.gap: No log scrubbing, no PII masking, no structured error handling preventing PII leakage through exception paths.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error handling preventing PII from leaking through exceptions. Add PII masking for any log output.

compensating_controls: Add try-catch with sanitized error messages
Implement global exception handler stripping PII

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No machine-readable API specification exists. No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model found.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec. Agent tool generation requires manual work.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI specification as part of API modernization (dependent on API-Q1).

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. Returns HTML pages with no error codes, no machine-readable error bodies. Exceptions propagate unhandled through Struts to WebLogic default error page.
findings.gap: No structured error format, no error codes, no retryable indicators.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error code, message, and retryable boolean.

findings.title: No Queryable Current State
findings.description: No queryable state endpoints. Application only writes loan applications — no mechanism to query existing applications or inspect current state.
findings.gap: No GET endpoints, no status query APIs, no read-before-write pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add query endpoints for application state as part of API modernization.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No proper sandbox or staging environment. README mentions 'shared UAT' but no environment separation in code or configuration.
findings.gap: No defined staging, no seed data, no environment configuration.
findings.recommendation: Create isolated staging environment with production-equivalent schema and synthetic data.

findings.title: No Input Validation — Active SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: No input validation at API boundary. SQL built via string concatenation with unvalidated user input (lf.getApplicantName()). Active SQL injection vulnerability.
findings.gap: No input validation, no parameterized queries for all fields, active SQL injection vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Fix SQL injection immediately by using parameterized queries. Add comprehensive input validation.

findings.title: No Temporal Metadata on Records
findings.description: No temporal metadata. INSERT statement has no created_at, updated_at, or event_time columns. No timezone handling, no freshness signaling.
findings.gap: No timestamps on records, no temporal metadata, no data freshness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Add temporal metadata columns (created_at, updated_at) with UTC timezone normalization.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no migration files, no API contracts, no breaking change detection, no changelog.
findings.gap: No versioning, no contract documentation, no migration tooling.
findings.recommendation: Implement database migrations (Flyway/Liquibase) and API versioning.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs. Zero observability instrumentation. Agent-initiated requests are undiagnosable.
findings.gap: No tracing, no structured logging, no correlation IDs.
findings.recommendation: Add structured JSON logging with correlation IDs and OpenTelemetry tracing.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configuration. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no SLO-based alerting.
findings.gap: No alerting thresholds for error rates or latency.
findings.recommendation: Implement alerting on error rates and latency for agent-facing APIs.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual WAR deployment to WebLogic admin console. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or any IaC files.
findings.gap: No IaC, no peer review for infrastructure changes, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK) when migrating to AWS.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Build system is Apache Ant with no build.xml in repository. No automated testing, no contract testing.
findings.gap: No CI/CD, no automated testing, no API contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated build, test, and API contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual WAR upload with no blue/green, no canary, no feature flags, no automated rollback.
findings.gap: No automated rollback, no deployment versioning.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability (CodeDeploy, ECS, or Kubernetes).

findings.title: Zero Automated Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. README explicitly states 'No unit tests.' No test files, no test frameworks in repository.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage of any kind.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated test suite covering loan calculation, input validation, and API contracts.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest for Financial Data
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Oracle 11g (EOL) stores financial PII with no TDE, no KMS, no encryption configuration.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for sensitive financial data.
findings.recommendation: Enable encryption at rest. Use RDS with KMS customer-managed keys when migrating to AWS.

findings.title: HTML-Only Response Format (No JSON/XML)
findings.description: All responses are HTML (JSP-rendered pages). No JSON or XML serialization. Agent tools cannot consume HTML responses directly.
findings.gap: Responses are human-readable HTML only — not machine-consumable.
findings.recommendation: Build JSON REST API as agent-facing surface.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission. INSERT operation has no associated event publishing (no SNS, EventBridge, SQS, Kafka, or CDC).
findings.gap: No event publishing for state changes.
findings.recommendation: Add event publishing (SNS or EventBridge) for loan application state changes.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. No X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After, or throttling information returned.
findings.gap: No rate limit signals for agents to self-throttle.
findings.recommendation: Document and implement rate limit headers when adding API Gateway.

findings.title: No Data Quality Metrics or Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness scores, or freshness SLAs. No profiling, no null rate monitoring, no duplicate detection.
findings.gap: No data quality visibility for agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring when establishing observability.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. No Glue Data Catalog, no schema documentation beyond the INSERT statement in source code.
findings.gap: No metadata describing what data the system holds.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary documenting the applications table schema and field semantics.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s or long-running workflows in this simple loan calculator.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service is not P0 priority and not on critical path.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results exist.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names (applicant, principal, rate, term, officer) are semantically meaningful and human-readable. No legacy codes requiring a data dictionary.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry of any kind — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 6 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Establish programmatic API, machine identity, audit logging, compensation, data residency controls, and foundational safety controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY items and RISK-QUALITY engineering maturity gaps. Establish observability, CI/CD, IaC, and schema management.
Implement quality improvements: test coverage, event emission, rate limit headers, data quality monitoring, and data catalog.

recommended_actions.action: Modernize to REST API with JSON endpoints
recommended_actions.rationale: The fundamental blocker: no programmatic API exists. All other improvements (auth, idempotency, structured errors) depend on having a REST API surface.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity and access control
recommended_actions.rationale: Without machine identity, no agent can be authenticated, authorized, or suspended. Foundation for all security controls.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with audit logging
recommended_actions.rationale: Audit logging requires identity. Identity propagation and credential management complete the auth story.
Write safety: compensation, concurrency controls, rate limiting, and blast radius limits prevent agent-caused data corruption.

recommended_actions.action: Establish data governance and residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Financial PII requires residency controls, access differentiation, PII redaction, and input validation to prevent regulatory violations.
Write-enabled agents submitting loan applications need draft states and approval gates for high-risk operations.
Operational foundation: tracing, alerting, IaC, CI/CD, rollback, testing, and encryption support safe ongoing operation.
